codename: Prism v1 — multi-charge analysis of the natural Boolean roster
role: Prism charges the Lattice v3 natural roster (270 arity<=3 Boolean relations -> 90 symmetry classes -> 166 both-real objective rows) with every oracle-derivable charge, computes the full pairwise Cramer's V matrix, nets each cell against what the dichotomy theorems force, and tests whether bounded-width absorbs the approx<->param coupling (I6). $0 compute; the theorems are the instrument. ONLY netted residuals are findings.
R0_sourcing_complete: I1/I2/I3 all IMPLEMENTABLE, no column drops to open. Verdicts + corrections in I_phase_verdicts below; folded into charge_table.

I_phase_verdicts.I1_ABISV_parallelization: Allender-Bauland-Immerman-Schnoor-Vollmer, JCSS 75 (2009), Thm 3.1: complete within-P lattice {trivial/coNLOGTIME, L, NL, parityL(oplus-L), P-complete} + NP-complete outside P, for EVERY finite Boolean Gamma. IMPLEMENTABLE from tuples but NOT a pure co-clone/polymorphism invariant: the [S02,R2] boundary L-vs-coNLOGTIME needs tuple inspection (their Ex 2.4). Prism builds the CO-CLONE-LEVEL column (matches oracles.py); the one tuple-boundary refinement is a documented simplification (affects only trivial R2 relations).
I_phase_verdicts.I2_DGJ_approx_counting: Dyer-Goldberg-Jerrum, JCSS 76 (2010) (arXiv:0710.4272), Thm 3 (verbatim): affine -> FP; else all relations in IM2 -> =ap #BIS (#RHPi1-complete); else =ap #SAT (no FPRAS unless NP=RP). IM2 = Inv({and,or}) = min-closed AND max-closed = Horn AND dual-Horn (agent verified min&max = IM2 exhaustively at arity<=3, 0 disagreements). Precedence: affine first. IMPLEMENTABLE, new column {FP, #BIS-equivalent, #SAT-equivalent}.
I_phase_verdicts.I3_bounded_width_CORRECTED: Barto-Kozik JACM 61 (2014) + Larose-Zadori + Feder-Vardi. CORRECT per-single-relation predicate: BW(R) = (0-valid OR 1-valid) OR Horn OR dual-Horn OR bijunctive — TRIVIAL-SATISFIABILITY FIRST. finer.classify_boolean's naive (horn v dual-horn v bijunctive) is WRONG: misclassifies 39 arity-3 relations that are 0/1-valid-but-not-Schaefer-tractable as not-BW (witness R={000,011,110}, 0-valid hence BW, but naive says not-BW). Affine obstruction (XOR unbounded-width) is REAL at language level but VACUOUS at arity<=3 single-relation (smallest witness is arity 4). Prism builds the CORRECTED is_bounded_width; the changed marginal is the right one for prediction 4.

SEALED_PREDICTIONS.1_NPI_calibration: decision column contains no intermediate value (Schaefer dichotomy: P or NPC only). Violation => pipeline failure, HALT.
SEALED_PREDICTIONS.2_identity_bet: decision<->counting nets to residual ~ 0 within the per-pair shared predicates (theorem-identity; confirms the netting detects identities).
SEALED_PREDICTIONS.3a_localization_identity_descriptive: bounded-width<->approximation associates at V >= 0.4 PRE-netting; its NETTED residual is 0, logged as an ENTAILMENT FINDING with derivation (KSTW's inputs contain bounded-width's determinants {horn, dual-horn, bijunctive}). Joins prediction 2 as a SECOND identity-class confirmation, NOT a miss.
SEALED_PREDICTIONS.3b_localization_coupling_the_real_bet: bounded-width<->PARAMETERIZED has a NONZERO netted residual — the only bounded-width pairing that can vary after netting (general weak-separability is orthogonal to the classical fingerprint). Underwrites prediction 4.
SEALED_PREDICTIONS.4_localization_absorption_the_I6_headlin: conditioning approx<->param on bounded-width shrinks V from 0.256 by >= HALF. Stratification, not netting (bounded-width varies across the population), legal as written.
SEALED_PREDICTIONS.4_SEALED_FINDINGS_NOTE: because bounded-width is a function of KSTW's inputs, any absorption found means 'the coupling is carried by localness structure the approximation classification already encodes' — a constituent claim with the entailment ACKNOWLEDGED IN THE SENTENCE, not left for a referee to discover.
SEALED_PREDICTIONS.5_outlier_persistence: no other charge pair's netted residual exceeds approx<->param's netted residual — the coupling stays the outlier even in the natural universe. Structural expectation: survivors are exactly the parameterized-involving pairs (param is the only charge with a determinant orthogonal to the classical fingerprint).
SEALED_PREDICTIONS.6_v3_addendum_Cai_Chen: netting the Cai-Chen-forced affine off-diagonal (APX-complete, FPT) raises monotonicity (netted Spearman > 0.019) while V stays within its CI (0.13, 0.398). CONTAMINATION DISCLOSED: v3's raw occupancy was already seen before sealing this (same posture as v3 disclosing v2's marginal).

the_netting_design.stratum_is_PER_PAIR: the intersection of the predicate sets the two oracles read — NOT the full _bool_profile. The full profile makes every classical charge constant in every stratum, mechanically zeroing classical x Lattice pairs and auto-failing prediction 3 / vacating prediction 5 (owner fix). Reuse r25._cramers_v + the within-stratum pooling pattern (census_residual_audit, r25.py:128-139) with the stratum = the shared predicates.
the_netting_design.a_pair_nets_to_0_iff: one charge is a function of the shared predicates (constant within the strata).
the_netting_design.classical_x_classical: share the full determining fingerprint -> residual 0 (pred 2).
the_netting_design.classical_x_approximation: KSTW approximation reads the ENTIRE classical fingerprint {0valid,1valid,horn,dual-horn,bijunctive,affine} + finer predicates, so every classical charge's determinants are a SUBSET of approximation's inputs -> classical constant within the shared strata -> nets to 0, incl. bounded-width<->approx (= prediction 3a).
the_netting_design.classical_x_parameterized: general weak-separability reads is_weakly_separable_general, ORTHOGONAL to the classical fingerprint -> shared ~ empty -> raw association is (mostly) the residual -> CAN survive (bounded-width<->param = prediction 3b).
the_netting_design.Lattice_x_Lattice: approx x approx, approx x param, param x param survive; approx<->param is v3's coupling.
the_netting_design.named_cross_charge_bridges_on_top: entailment layer — counting=FP=>decision=P; bounded-width=>decision=P; parallel-only-within-P; Cai-Chen approx in MAX-SNP => FPT + EPTAS<->FPT on the approx<->param cell (the folded-in v3 netting: remove the forced (APX-complete,FPT) affine rows, recompute V AND Spearman = pred 6). Each cell logs its derivation (theorem, entailed structure, subtraction).
the_netting_design.secondary_lens: full-fingerprint conditioning (all predicates any oracle reads) zeros EVERY cell — the census wall at full strength — reported as the strong-form check.
the_netting_design.structural_headline: approximation SUBSUMES the classical Schaefer fingerprint; the ONLY charge reading an orthogonal determinant is general weak-separability. That is WHY parameterized is special and approx<->param is the outlier — a structural expectation, not just an empirical bet.
